name: company
description: A company (employer or search firm). One entity per real-world company; postings and applications refer to it by id (e.g. co_gasangtech).

name.description: Display name as most commonly written, e.g. '(주)가상테크'.

normalized_name.description: Normalized name key for identity matching: legal-form markers such as (주)/주식회사/Inc removed, spaces removed, lower-cased. e.g. '가상테크'.

aliases.description: Other names the same company is known by (Korean/English names, old names), e.g. ['Gasang Tech'].

business_number.description: Korean business registration number (사업자등록번호) 'NNN-NN-NNNNN', if known. Strongest identity key.
